messages:
maya: quick sync - we need to choose a direction for the runtime facade across hosted/dedicated/private. two options: tiny probe-based handshake vs. a richer feature manifest. capture tradeoffs + rollout plan. thoughts?

sam: tiny probe. keep surface minimal; fewer invariants to maintain. routing can handle fallbacks. :thumbsup:

jin: tiny is nice for hosted but private often lacks capabilities (KMS/HSM, egress). we must support an explicit 'unsupported' signal and a canonical fallback so callers don't get opaque failures.
alex: propose a layered schema: core probe (boolean capability bits) + optional extended manifest for Dedicated/Private with tuning knobs (batch-shaping, kv-shard hints, secret_policy). example: `{"version":"1.0","capabilities":["streaming","kv_cache"],"fallbacks":{"kv_cache":"no-cache"}}`

rachel: Dedicated customers will want extra controls (batch window, max-concurrency). how do we avoid fragmentation where clients rely on extended features Hosted can't satisfy?
tom: make extended manifest opt-in and non-breaking. core behavior must be deterministic; extended features only for routes that declare them as required.
sam: control plane must maintain a compatibility matrix and routing policy that understands required features per route. otherwise silent degradations.
jin: add a KMS_attestation bit so the control plane refuses to route secrets to runtimes that can't attest - prevents accidental secret exposure.
maya: rollout plan: RFC + proto -> implement probe handler -> internal alpha on DevBench -> opt-in Dedicated customers behind feature flag -> observe 2 weeks -> flip to strict negotiation.
ops-bot: rollout checklist created: manifest-handler v0.1 -> canary 3 hosts -> monitor 15m -> expand to 10% traffic -> 24h stability gate.
alex: logging: when a fallback occurs emit a compact human-readable reason, e.g. 'routed-to-no-cache: perf-risk=+15%'. helps SRE and product triage.
rachel: request: someone draft the minimal core schema and the extended schema keys so I can add them to the Dedicated playbook.
maya: i'll draft the RFC stub with core vs extended schema, negotiation state machine, and migration checklist. tagging @sam @jin for review. followups in thread.
